FN-PSS21RE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 328
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/28/2025
House Bill 328 as introduced would codify current practice of the Alabama National Guard
regarding the provision of certain legal services. This bill would not otherwise affect state or
local funding.
